project_tracker_diagnostic: Perennial; tall and usually unbranched or sparsely branched; numerous narrow linear-lanceolate leaves that often fold lengthwise and curve downward; many yellow heads.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common and useful Central Texas field-learning taxon.

morphology_keys.habit: Tall herb, often forming colonies; stems typically more upright and less freely branching than H. annuus.
morphology_keys.leaves: Numerous, narrow linear-lanceolate leaves, often folded lengthwise, rough, frequently curving downward; mostly alternate but lower leaves may be opposite/subopposite.
morphology_keys.heads: Many yellow heads borne in elongated inflorescences.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
